name: The Romanos
positioning: The Romanos, a Luxury Collection Resort, Costa Navarino: a beachfront resort by the Ionian Sea in the Navarino Dunes area, with private-pool rooms, butler-served villas, Anazoe Spa and golf and tennis at Costa Navarino
best_for: Couples wanting a room or villa with its own pool by the Ionian Sea

facts.text: The Romanos sits by the Ionian Sea in the Navarino Dunes area of Costa Navarino.
All rooms at the hotel are pet-friendly.
Accommodations have sea, golf or garden views, and many have a private infinity pool facing the Ionian sunset.
The Romanos Ionian Exclusive suites and villas come with 24/7 butler service.
Royal Villa Methoni is built with native stone and local design elements, right on The Dunes Beach.
Anazoe Spa treatments draw on ancient beauty practices and the teachings of Hippocrates.
Guests can play four signature golf courses at Costa Navarino.
The Mouratoglou Tennis Center has tennis, padel and pickleball courts.
Barbouni serves seafood lunches by the beach beside the Ionian Sea.
The hotel has a gym, health center and indoor pool.
Conde Nast Traveler says the resort is aimed at couples, with plunge pools in nearly all its ground-floor rooms.
The Romanos has low-slung buildings wrapped around a series of lit lagoons.

highlights.text: The Ionian Exclusive beachfront villas have a private pool, sea views and direct access to The Dunes Beach.
Anazoe Spa offers signature therapies and oleotherapy treatments inspired by the health and beauty practices of ancient Greece.
The Mouratoglou Tennis Center at Navarino Dunes is the first European location of Mouratoglou Tennis Center, with courts overlooking the Ionian Sea.
The Dunes Course, the first signature golf course in Greece, was designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design.
The resort sits among olive and citrus groves and rolling hills, beside a kilometre-long stretch of golden sand on the Ionian Sea.

considerations.text: Messinia is a remote corner of the southwest Peloponnese, about a four-hour drive from Athens or one hour from Kalamata airport.
The rooms do not have a work space.
Navarino Agora, the open-air dining, shopping and culture hub, sits near both The Romanos and The Westin Resort Costa Navarino.
